specific_requirements: CLI queries exactly one explicitly supplied local-environment task ID (EZVIZ_CLOUD_TASK_ID) in chosen mode. No task creation by default.

Document sync/async explicit create_interval_task/create_timing_task -> task -> storage.search_files -> storage.download_urls calls, keeping sensitive values in local variables and invoking each step explicitly.
No automatic poll, create space/recording, download media or infer fileNodeId from task response. Guide tagId=taskId is distinct cross-source evidence.

Offline example exercise verifies new task query plus existing storage search/download wire using synthetic identities; taskStatus0/3 semantics preserved, no playable-image conclusion.

specific_requirements: Provide bounded sync and async programmatic run functions: caller supplies client, group, mandatory batch handler and max_batches int1..10 (example limit, not official API limit). Create one consumer, then at most max_batches explicit consume calls, offset omitted.

Validate create data.consumerId shape locally before consuming; preserve SDK result/raw, do not print identity. For each batch, finish/await handler before the next consume. Handler failure/cancellation stops immediately; finally/close never performs a commit read.

Do not supply a default count-only handler that silently acknowledges messages. CLI is an explicit --execute one-batch observation: create once/consume once, report counts and processing_performed=false/final_commit_confirmed=false; no second consume.
First empty batch is not no-message proof; final batch is not confirmed committed. No offset arithmetic or dedupe helper; body remains opaque and never logged.

Tests use real SDK MockTransport and a trace to prove create/read/handler/read ordering, handler exception and cancellation produce no extra business request, and no cleanup/network work happens on close/import.

architecture_choice.selected: Three thin stateless domestic facades and explicit repository examples; no runtime dependency on LLM/harness/data.
alternatives_rejected: Merge legacy consumer into webhook helpers: acknowledgement and lifecycle semantics differ.
Managed background task/consumer engine: introduces unknown replay/commit policy and implicit operations.
architecture_choice.official_component_boundary: These are server APIs; no player/codec/RTC engine or App adapter is built. Existing official media components remain preferred for playback.

shared_invariants: No change to existing operation responses/exceptions/order/retries. New scopes wrap region and validation, including pre-auth errors.
No automatic collection/upload/file logs/global HTTPX modification/background SDK business requests. Diagnostic operation names extend exact allowlists only.
Reuse existing request redaction; add consumerId only. Reports omit raw messages/headers/body, values, IDs, offsets, URLs and exception details; unknown errors retain current generic classification.
None means omit all optional parameters; no server defaults injected, no implicit resource discovery or selection.
Known request values redacted without changing raw business-code classification, including short numeric-looking IDs; arbitrary unknown error text is not claimed universally scrubbed.
Source facts, local validation choices, cross-source evidence and LIVE results are separate. No new live call or side-effect authorization is granted.

SP199 left1357 wire/envelope uncertain; E41 official HTTP sample establishes form and E45 response keys establish code/msg/data; preserve differences from E49 flattened business table.

SP211 source cards R excludes the header; SP212 cards each declare their own convention (messaging excludes header; capture includes it). Use element_index and field name as the stable locator rather than assuming one R convention.
1389 method/path declarations E9/E13 and Body accessToken table are direct endpoint facts, not inference from1388. Form encoding uses E92.

983/984 E7 declare https://open.ys7.com; source projection omitted origin but source did not. Do not register host as missing.

Do not adopt candidate DTOs/taskId-only returns, header/channel coercion, implicit poll/backoff, SDK deduplication, strict start<end, timing-mode2 exclusion, mutual exclusion of both storage selectors, or channel default1.
1388 devProto empty is an allowed value, not a declared server default. 1389 channelNo wording可填1 does not remove requiredness.
